text: From now on, stolen-card cases go straight through.
question: Which do you mean by “stolen-card case”?

choices.label: Confirmed: the fraud team or bank confirmed the card was stolen

rule.title: Stolen card confirmed by fraud team or bank → approve in full
rule.note: Policy 5: refund the real cardholder in full

choices.label: Reported: the cardholder reported the card stolen or the purchase unauthorised

rule.title: Card reported stolen or unauthorised → approve in full
rule.note: Policy 5: refund the real cardholder in full
